title: Using the HylooSec Chat Page
description: Learn how to view conversations, open a chat, read messages, send text, emojis and multiple media files, and view another user's profile information.

blocks.text: After successfully logging in, HylooSec opens the main chat page. This page contains the application sidebar, your conversation list and the main chat area.
When no conversation is selected, the main area displays the Select a conversation screen. Select any available conversation from the chat list to open its complete chat window.

items.name: Application Sidebar
items.description: Contains navigation controls for important sections of HylooSec. Find User and Settings are explained separately in their own guides.

items.name: Conversation List
items.description: Displays users with whom you already have an active or registered conversation.

items.name: Main Chat Area
items.description: Displays either the default Select a conversation screen or the currently selected conversation.

blocks.text: Until you select a conversation, the main chat area displays a default screen asking you to select a conversation.

blocks.title: End-to-End Encryption
blocks.text: The default screen also informs you that chats are end-to-end encrypted.

items.title: View Your Conversations
items.description: Check the available users in the conversation list.

items.title: Select a Conversation
items.description: Click a user from the conversation list.

items.title: Open the Chat
items.description: The selected user's conversation will appear in the main chat area.

blocks.text: The conversation list appears beside the application sidebar and provides a quick summary of your active chats.

items.name: Profile Image
items.description: Displays the user's current profile image or a default profile icon.

items.name: User Name
items.description: Displays the name selected by the user for their HylooSec account.

items.name: Last Message
items.description: Displays a preview of the most recent message in the conversation.

items.name: Message Timestamp
items.description: Displays the time or date associated with the latest message.

items.name: Last Online Time
items.description: Displays when the user was last online.

items.name: Account Creation Time
items.description: If a user has created an account but has never logged in, HylooSec may display the account creation time instead of a last-online time.

items.name: Selected Conversation
items.description: The currently opened conversation is visually highlighted in the list.

items.title: Locate the User
items.description: Find the required user in your conversation list.

items.title: Select the User
items.description: Click the user's conversation entry.

items.title: View Chat History
items.description: The chat window opens and displays the messages exchanged with that user.

blocks.text: The top of an opened conversation contains the selected user's profile image, name and current online or last-seen information.

items.title: View Basic Information
items.description: Check the user's name, profile image and online or last-seen status in the chat header.

items.title: Open User Details
items.description: Click the chat header to open the user's detailed profile panel.

blocks.text: Clicking the user information in the chat header opens a detailed profile panel for that user.

items.name: Profile Image
items.description: Displays a larger version of the user's profile image.

items.name: Name
items.description: Displays the user's selected HylooSec name.

items.name: Bio
items.description: Displays the profile bio or mood added by the user.

items.name: User ID
items.description: Displays the unique HylooSec User ID associated with the account.

items.name: Media, Links and Documents
items.description: Provides access to supported media, links and documents shared in the conversation when available.

items.name: Mute Notifications
items.description: Allows conversation notification controls when the option is available.

items.name: Close Button
items.description: Closes the user details panel and returns to the conversation.

blocks.text: The central chat window displays the complete available conversation history between you and the selected user.

items.name: Received Messages
items.description: Messages received from the other user appear on the opposite side of your sent messages.

items.name: Sent Messages
items.description: Messages sent by you appear using the outgoing message style.

items.name: Message Time
items.description: Each message displays the time at which it was sent.

items.name: Date Separators
items.description: Messages from different dates are separated using date labels.

items.name: Message Status
items.description: Outgoing messages may display their current sending, sent, delivered or seen status.

blocks.text: HylooSec supports long text messages containing thousands of characters.

blocks.title: More Button
blocks.text: When a text message exceeds 200 characters, HylooSec displays a More option so that the complete message can be expanded and read.

items.title: Locate the Long Message
items.description: Open the conversation containing the long message.

items.title: Click More
items.description: Select the More option displayed with the message.

items.title: Read the Full Message
items.description: The remaining message content will be displayed.

blocks.text: The message composer is located at the bottom of the chat window. It contains the media selector, emoji selector, message input and Send button.

items.name: Media Selector
items.description: Allows you to select supported files from your device.

items.name: Emoji Selector
items.description: Opens the emoji picker so that emojis can be inserted into your message.

items.name: Message Input
items.description: Allows you to write and edit your text message.

items.name: Send Button
items.description: Sends the prepared text, emojis, files or a supported combination of them.

items.title: Open a Conversation
items.description: Select the user you want to message.

items.title: Write Your Message
items.description: Click the message input and enter your text.

items.title: Review the Message
items.description: Check the message before sending it.

items.title: Send the Message
items.description: Click the Send button.

blocks.title: Empty Messages
blocks.text: The Send button will not send a message when no text, emoji or file has been added.

items.title: Open the Emoji Selector
items.description: Click the emoji icon beside the message input.

items.title: Choose an Emoji
items.description: Select one or more emojis from the available emoji picker.

items.title: Add Optional Text
items.description: You may add text before or after the selected emojis.

items.title: Send
items.description: Click the Send button to deliver the message.

blocks.text: HylooSec allows you to select and send multiple supported files in a conversation.

blocks.title: File Size Limit
blocks.text: Each selected file can be up to 10 MB. Files larger than the supported limit may not be accepted.

items.title: Open the Media Selector
items.description: Click the attachment or media icon beside the message input.

items.title: Select Files
items.description: Choose one or multiple supported files from your device.

items.title: Review Selected Files
items.description: Check the selected files before submitting them.

items.title: Add Optional Text
items.description: You may include a text message or emojis with the selected files.

items.title: Send the Files
items.description: Click the Send button and wait while the files are processed and uploaded.

blocks.title: Do Not Close the Page During Upload
blocks.text: Keep the conversation open until the selected files have finished processing and sending.

items.label: Sending
items.description: The message or file is currently being processed.

items.label: Sent
items.description: The message has been successfully sent from your account.

items.label: Delivered
items.description: The message has reached the recipient.

items.label: Seen
items.description: The recipient has opened or viewed the message.

blocks.text: HylooSec may display a user's current online status or the last time the user was active.

items: Online indicates that the user is currently connected to HylooSec.
Last seen indicates the most recent recorded activity time.
If the account has never been used for login, the displayed time may represent the account creation time.
Status information may update when the user's connection changes.

items.solution: Select a user from the conversation list.
Add text, an emoji or at least one supported file before clicking Send.

items.problem: A file cannot be selected or sent
items.solution: Check that the file type is supported and that the individual file size does not exceed 10 MB.

items.problem: A long message is not completely visible
items.solution: Click the More option displayed with the message.
Click its close icon to return to the complete chat window.
Check your internet connection and wait for HylooSec to reconnect.
Keep the page open, check your internet connection and wait for the upload to complete.

items: Verify the recipient's User ID before sharing private information.
Do not send passwords, security keys, recovery answers or account documents through chat.
Avoid opening unexpected files received from unknown users.
Do not leave an active HylooSec session unattended on a shared device.
Use the official HylooSec website when accessing your conversations.

popup.title: Chat Page Help
content: Select a user from the conversation list to open a chat.
Click the chat header to view the user's profile details.
Use the message box to enter text.
Use the emoji icon to add emojis.
Use the attachment icon to select multiple files.
Each selected file can be up to 10 MB.
Messages longer than 200 characters display a More option.
An empty message cannot be sent.
